spans.s:
(इ) भदि r. 1st and 10th cls. (भन्दति-ते भन्दयति)
1 To do an auspicious act.
2 To be happy, well, prosperous, &c.
3 To shine.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
1 Reverend, venerable, worshipped or adored.
2 Brilliant, splendid.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A Saugata, a Bauddha, a heterodox or sceptical philosopher.
2 A devotee, an ascetic.
E.
भदि to be happy or pleased, to shine, Uṇādi aff. झच्, and the nasal rejected.

mn. (-कः-कं)
Prosperous, fortunate, auspicious.
E.
भदि to be happy, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
1 Happy, prosperous, lucky, propitious.
2 Best, excellent.
3 Pure, pious, virtuous.
n. subst. (-द्रं)
Prosperity, fortune, happiness.
(adv.)
Happy, well, right.
n. (-द्रं)
1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
2

Gold.
3

Iron or steel.
nf. (-द्रं-द्री)
One of the astrological periods called Karaṇas, the seventh; also called Viṣṭī, regarded as an unlucky period.
m. (-द्रः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A wagtail.
3 A bull.
4 A heap, a multitude.
5 A description of elephant, one of four classes into which they are divided.
6 Mount

Meru.
7

One of the nine persons termed Śuklabalas by the Jainas.
f. (-द्रा)
1 The Ganges of heaven.
2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना.
3

Indigo.
4

Asclepias pseudosarsa.
5 A shrub, (Pœderia foetida.)
6 A medicinal plant, commonly

Kayaphal.
7

A name of the second, seventh, and twelfth days of the lunar fortnight.
8 A female Śakti or deity of the

Jainas.
9
One of the four divisions of the Ganges, according to the Purāṇas, that which flows to the northern

Kuru.
10

A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
11 A cow.
12 Turmerick.
E.
भदि to be happy, Uṇādi aff. रन् and the nasal rejected.

m. (-द्रः)
The name of a month, (August-September,) when the moon is full near the wing of Pegasus.
E.
भद्र for भद्रपदा, and अण् aff.: see the next.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable.
2 Respectable, worthy, estimable.
3 Lucky, fortunate.
n. (-कं)
A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
m. (-कः)
A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ली)
1 One of the forms of the goddess

DURGĀ.
2

A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis or rotundus.)
E.
भद्र ŚIVA, क्ल to approximate, aff. घञ and ङीप्.

m. (-म्भः)
A golden jar filled with water from a holy place, or with the water of the Ganges, and used especially at the consecration of a king.
E.
भद्र auspicious, and कुम्भ a water jar.

f. (-का)
A creeping plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa, the narrow-leaved variety.)
E.
भद्र auspicious, and गन्ध smell, aff. कन् and टाप्; some copies read भद्रवल्लिका in place of this word.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or prosperity.
E.
भद्र happy, and कृ to make, aff. खश्.

m. (-डः)
A sort of Euphorbia, (E. tirucalli.)
E.
भद्र propitious, and चूडा a crest.

m. (-रुः)
A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
भद्र auspicious, and दारु wood.

m. (-कः)
A class of thirty-nine medicinal plants, and substances.
E.
भद्रदारु the pine, आदि etcetera, कन् added.

m. (-मा)
The woodpecker.
E.
भद्र auspicious, and नामन a name.

f. (-दा)
A name given to the 26th and 27th lunar asterisms: see भाद्रपदा.

m. (-दः)
The month Bhādra.
E.
भद्रपदा the asterism, and अण् aff.
f. (-दा)
A name common to the twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets prior, and subsequent, or पूर्व्व and उत्तरः see पूर्व्वभाद्रपदा, &c.
E.
भद्रा said to mean a cow, and पद foot, अण् added optionally, whence it is often read भद्रपदा.

f. (-र्णा)
A shrub, (Pœderia foetida.)
E.
भद्र auspicious, पर्ण a leaf, and टाप् fem. aff.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
2 A shrub, (Pœderia fœtida.)
E.
भद्र lucky, पर्ण a leaf, and ङीष् fem. aff.

m. (-नः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
भद्र conferring happiness, and बल to be strong, aff. युच्.

f. (-ला)
A shrub, (Poederia foetida.)

f. (-का)
A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)

m. (-कः)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
E.
भद्र lucky, and मुस्तक Cyperus.

n. (-वं)
The seed of the Echites or Wrightea antidysenterica.
E.
भद्र lucky, and यव seed.

m. (-णुः)
The elephant of INDRA.
E.
भद्र auspicious, and रेणु dust.

f. (-ती)
A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)

m. (-र्म्मा)
Double jasmine.

f. (-ल्ली)
1 Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
2 The large Bengal creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
E.
भद्र lucky, and वल्ली a creeper.

n. (-यं)
Sandal.
E.
भद्र auspicious, श्रय for आश्रय asylum, place of growing.

m. (-यः)
Sandal wood.
E.
भद्र auspicious, and आश्रय abode, habitat.

f. (-श्रीः)
Sandal wood.
E.
भद्र best, श्री excellence or beauty.

f. (-मा)
A name of GAṄGĀ.
E.
भद्र ŚIVA, स with or equal to, उमा the wife of ŚIVA; equally dear with UMĀ to that deity.

n. (-णं)
Shaving.
E.
भद्र auspicious, with डाच् aff., and कृ to do, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-जः)
A sword, a scimitar.
E.
भद्र iron, and आत्मज born.

m. (-कः)
One of the eighteen minor Dvīpas, or divisions of the world.
E.
भद्र prosperity, ऋ to go to, or attain, aff. ण्वुल्.

f. (-का)
A shrub, (Poederia foetida.)
E.
भद्र auspicious, अल what is equal to, and पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्.

f. (-ली)
A shrub, (Poederia foetida.)
E.
भद्रा the same plant, ला to go or be, aff. ड and ङीष्.

n. (-श्वं)
One of the four Mahā Dvīpas, into which the known world is divided, according to some systems; or according to another system, one of the nine Khāṇḍas, or smaller divisions of the continent; in either case it is the east division.
m. (-श्वः)
One of the nine sons of AGNĪDHRA, to whom the division of the earth called Bhadrāśva was assigned, and from whom it was so named.
E.
भद्र auspicious, अश्व a horse.

n. (-नं)
1 A throne.
2 A peculiar posture, in which abstract meditation is performed by the devotee; the legs bent, and crossed underneath, and turned so as to bring the ancles in contact with the perineum, whilst the soles of the feet are [] held close to the sides.
E.
भद्र auspicious or beautiful, and आसन a seat or sitting.

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)

m. (-रः)
The son of a virtuous and loyal wife.
E.
भद्र auspicious, मातृ a mother, aff. अण्.
